rows.title: HN-204 Clinical Study

rows.content:
# Figure, p.11

Figure description (generated by the parser, not document text):
This line graph illustrates the percentage of participants experiencing treatment-emergent adverse events across three categories: HN-204, HN-311, and HN-402, as displayed on the x-axis. The y-axis represents the percentage of participants, ranging from 17.0% to 20.0%, with increments of 0.5%.

Here are the facts and conclusions derived from the graph:
*   For HN-204, approximately 18.2% of participants experienced treatment-emergent adverse events.
*   For HN-311, approximately 16.9% of participants experienced treatment-emergent adverse events.
*   For HN-402, approximately 20.2% of participants experienced treatment-emergent adverse events.
*   The lowest percentage of treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in the HN-311 category, at about 16.9%.
*   The highest percentage of treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in the HN-402 category, at about 20.2%.
*   There was a decrease in the percentage of participants with adverse events from HN-204 to HN-311.
*   Subsequently, there was a significant increase in the percentage of participants with adverse events from HN-311 to HN-402.
